# Taskly

> Taskly is an Angular task management application for teams to organize projects, tasks, and collaboration in one place.

## Notes
- Taskly uses Angular with Client-Side Rendering (CSR).
- Authentication and data are handled via Supabase.

## Docs
- [Home](https://taskly-99u5.vercel.app/)
- [Login](https://taskly-99u5.vercel.app/login)

## Features
- Authentication
- Project Management
- Kanban Board
- Task CRUD
- Epic Management
- Member Invitations
- Email Verification
- SEO Optimization

## Technologies
- Angular
- Supabase
